Senior Project Manager – Sovos SOVOS Senior Project Manager

Managed & Professional Services

Full-Time
United Kingdom

Build Your Future With Us

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

The Role

At Sovos, we're building the future of tax compliance technology across Europe. We're looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our European Professional Services team, with the ability to be based in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, or Spain. This is a senior delivery role for someone who understands the complexity of enterprise SaaS implementations and brings deep familiarity with tax compliance, e-invoicing, or regulatory technology. You'll own end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-country implementations for enterprise clients across EMEA, operating with autonomy and directly impacting client satisfaction and the reputation of Sovos Professional Services in Europe.

More Specifically, You Will

Own end-to-end project delivery for enterprise e-invoicing and tax compliance implementations across multiple EMEA countries simultaneously.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation for client stakeholders, from project teams to executive sponsors, throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Lead structured project governance, including weekly status meetings, monthly steering committee sessions, and go/no-go decision processes, in alignment with Sovos delivery methodology.
Manage project scope rigorously; identify, document, and drive change orders when client requests exceed agreed statement-of-work boundaries, and track project hours against retainer balances.
Coordinate cross-functional Sovos resources (Solution Consultants, Technical Consultants, SAP specialists, Regulatory, and Product teams) to deliver against project commitments.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans, risk registers, issue logs, and status reports; proactively surface risks and drive resolution before they become escalations, leveraging AI tools to improve efficiency and insights where appropriate.
Contribute to continuous improvement of Professional Services delivery methodology, statement-of-work templates, onboarding playbooks, and project governance frameworks based on insights from your client portfolio.

What You Bring to Sovos

You've successfully delivered enterprise SaaS implementations in a client-facing Professional Services environment, particularly in the tax compliance, e-invoicing, VAT, or regulatory technology space.
You've successfully managed complex, multi-stakeholder implementations with enterprise clients (500M+ revenue) across multiple countries and time zones concurrently.
You have hands-on experience with retainer-based Professional Services engagements, including scope management, change order discipline, and hour burn-down governance.
You're an exceptional stakeholder manager, able to build trust with client executives and navigate competing priorities without losing delivery momentum, and you bring strong commercial acumen around project delivery, revenue recognition, and margin.
You're a proactive risk manager and clear, structured communicator (written and verbal), capable of adapting tone and detail level for technical teams, client project managers, and executive sponsors alike, and you're comfortable operating with ambiguity and adapting quickly as client needs evolve.
You're proficient with project management tooling (e.g. Salesforce, Jira, or equivalent PSA/CRM platforms); PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification preferred; Background in Business, Information Systems, Finance, or equivalent experience.
Fluency in English required; proficiency in French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Polish is a meaningful advantage given the client base. Experience with SAP-integrated implementations (SAP ECC, S/4HANA, or Process Orchestration) and familiarity with EMEA e-invoicing mandates (France, Germany, Poland, Turkey, etc.) are significant advantages. Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and tools is valued.
Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

Life at Sovos

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

Global Mentoring Programs
AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
Continuous Learning and Development
Language Learning Support
Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
Global Parental Leave Policy

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

Acting as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation lifecycle, you will coordinate internal stakeholders, external partners, and customers to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest quality standards.

You will work closely with Sales, Design, Operations, Construction, Security, Network Engineering, and Customer Success teams to manage customer implementations ranging from colocation deployments to complex infrastructure projects.

Customer Implementations & Project Delivery

Role- SAP BRIM Project Manager

Location- San Jose, CA

Duration: Long Term

Position
Overview We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Project Manager / Support Lead to manage our production support, continuous enhancement, and operational governance across the SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) landscape. This role combines hands-on functional understanding of core BRIM pillars with project management discipline. You will lead a blended onshore/offshore team, enforce ITIL-based SLA/KPI targets, drive critical incident resolution, and govern small-to-medium business enhancements from scoping to hypercare.

Key Responsibilities

1. Support Operations & SLA Governance Lead day-to-day operations for Level 2 and Level 3 production support across the entire SAP BRIM suite. Own and report operational KPIs: mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), SLA compliance (>98%), ticket backlog trends, and first-time-fix rates. Serve as the primary escalation point for Priority 1/2 billing, mediation, rating, and invoicing incidents; lead root cause analyses (RCA) and post-mortem discussions. Manage high-volume recurring operations: month-end billing cycles, automated rating batches, bill-run failures, out-of-sequence consumption data, and financial posting reconciliations.
2. Project Management & Continuous Improvement Manage minor release cadences, change requests (CRs), and platform enhancements using hybrid Agile/Scrum or Waterfall frameworks. Own project schedules, resource allocations, sprint backlogs, risk/issues/assumptions/dependencies (RAID) logs, and release readiness checklists. Coordinate end-to-end delivery: requirement discovery, solution design review, build, system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, cutover, and post-deployment stabilization. Interface directly with business finance, IT steering committees, external System Integrators (SIs), and vendor partners.
3. Functional Oversight & Solution Integrity Provide functional governance across core modules: SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management): Subscription lifecycle, master agreements, product catalog, provider contracts. SAP CC (Convergent Charging): Rating and charging logic, charge plans, allowance logic, subscriber mapping. SAP CI (Convergent Invoicing): Billable items (BITs), consumption items (CITs), bill runs, aggregation, invoicing rules. SAP RAR: Revenue postings, reconciliation & rev-rec. Coordinate integration integrity with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP CPQ, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), external CRM, and data mediation layers.

Required Qualifications & Experience Total Experience:

8+ years of IT delivery/support experience, with at least 4+ years dedicated to SAP BRIM (formerly Hybris Billing) and 3+ years running project management or application maintenance services (AMS).
Core Technical Expertise: Functional or technical depth in at least two of the four BRIM components (SOM, CC, CI, RAR) alongside familiarity with the overall end-to-end data pipeline.
Support Frameworks: Proven experience running structured ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management) using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or SAP Solution Manager.

Project Delivery:
Demonstrated success managing cross-functional technical teams (developers, functional consultants, BASIS, middleware teams) across distributed time zones. Integration Acumen: Familiarity with modern SAP interface technologies (OData, REST APIs, IDocs, SAP CPI) and reconciliation between rated events and general ledger entries.

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.

About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the heartbeat of an e-commerce P&L, and where it's headed next.

You will own the truth behind our financial numbers and how we forecast them. We need a Financial Modeling Master who can build the forecasts our Finance team plans around, plus the predictive models that make those forecasts sharper, all grounded in rigorously reconciled data.

Additionally, you will act as a critical partner to our Finance team and leadership, bridging the gap between raw transaction data, payment processors, and the financial plan.

What You'll Do

1. Forecasting

Financial Forecasts:
Build and own forecasts for revenue, orders, subscription renewals, and cash by brand and channel.
Scenario Planning:
Develop scenario and sensitivity models that help Finance plan budgets.
Forecast Accuracy:
Track accuracy over time and refine forecasts as the business changes.

2. Predictive Modeling

Customer & SKU-Level Models:
Build, validate, and maintain predictive models, such as subscription renewal and cancellation likelihood, refund and chargeback risk, and SKU-level demand, using statistical and machine learning methods (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, gradient boosting).
Sharper Forecasts:
Feed model outputs into revenue and cash forecasts so projections reflect who is likely to renew, cancel, or refund, not just historical trends.
Model Health:
Monitor model performance over time and retrain as customer behavior shifts.

3. Financial Reporting & Unit Economics

P&L Reporting:
Own reporting on revenue, gross vs. net sales, discounts, refunds, COGS, and contribution margin by brand, channel, and product.
Unit Economics:
Own contribution margin, payback, and profitability reporting by brand, channel, and product.
Variance Analysis:
Produce budget-vs-actual analysis that explains what moved and why.

4. Financial Data Integrity & Reconciliation

Reconciliation Ownership:
Own reconciliation across payment processors ( Stripe, Shopify Payments, Amazon
), bank deposits, our internal database, and accounting ( QuickBooks
) to ensure every dollar is accounted for.
Root Cause Leadership:
Lead investigations of revenue discrepancies and drive fixes at the source with our Data Engineer.
Single Source of Truth:
Define and document the business logic behind financial metrics for the whole company.

5. Data Transformation & Visualization

Data Preparation:
Use dbt
or Python
to build the financial datasets and models behind forecasting and reporting.
Business Logic Application:
Write efficient SQL in Snowflake
that reflects our financial business rules.
Dashboarding:
Design, build, and maintain high-impact dashboards in Sigma
for Finance and executive leadership.

6. Leadership & Collaboration

Finance Partnership:
Present forecasts and model findings to Finance and executive leadership, including the assumptions and risks behind them.
Raise the Bar:
Review other analysts' work and mentor them on financial data quality and modeling.

What We're Looking For

The Essentials (Experience & Tech Stack)

Experience Level:
5+ years of data or financial analytics experience, with meaningful time in DTC, subscription, or consumer businesses. (We are looking for a senior, hands-on individual contributor, not a people manager.)
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling:
Hands-on experience with both: building financial forecasts (e.g., time-series, regression) and predictive models (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, gradient boosting) that leadership used to make decisions. Both are required.
Financial Acumen:
strong grasp of accounting principles, and familiarity with compiling financial statements and cash flows.
Industry:
Proven experience in DTC E-commerce
is required. You must be comfortable with Shopify
, Amazon Seller Central
, and Stripe
data.
Warehousing & BI:
Expert SQL in Snowflake
, strong Python
(pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, Prophet, or similar), and proficiency with Sigma
. We're open to candidates experienced with Tableau, Looker, or Power BI who can adapt quickly.
Spreadsheets:
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
AI Tools:
Fluency with Claude Code
(or comparable AI coding tools) for data manipulation and analytics.
ELT Familiarity:
Awareness of how ELT tools (like Hevo, Fivetran, Airbyte, Azure
, etc.) function, so you can communicate effectively with our Data Engineer.

The "Financial Modeling Master" Skill Set

You have a proven track record of designing forecasts that executive leadership relies on for strategic planning, along with the ability to articulate variance drivers and continuously calibrate model accuracy.
You know when a time-series forecast is enough and when a customer-level predictive model will do better.

report structures and month-end close is a plus.

new_jobs.description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

We are looking for a mid-level Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the heartbeat of an e-commerce P&L.

You will not just analyze data; you will own the truth behind our revenue numbers and help Finance see what's coming next. We need a Financial Data Master who understands payment processors, core financial concepts, and forecasting, and who knows how raw transaction data becomes a P&L the business can trust.

Additionally, you will act as a critical partner to our Finance team, bridging the gap between raw data, payment processors, our financial reporting, and the forecast.

What You'll Do

1. Forecasting

Financial Forecasts:
Build and maintain forecasts for revenue, orders, subscription renewals, and expenses by brand and channel, and keep them current as actuals come in.
Forecast vs. Actual:
Track how forecasts compare to actuals, explain the gaps, and flag meaningful misses to the Finance team.
Budget Support:
Update the scenarios and assumptions Finance uses for budget planning.

2. Financial Reporting & Unit Economics

P&L Reporting:
Build and maintain reporting on revenue, gross vs. net sales, discounts, refunds, COGS, and contribution margin by brand, channel, and product.
Unit Economics:
Report on contribution margin, payback, and profitability by brand, channel, and product.
Month-End Close:
Support month-end close with timely, tied-out data.
Budget vs. Actual:
Produce variance reporting that explains what moved and why.

3. Financial Data Integrity & Reconciliation

Reconciliation Investigations:
Act as the lead investigator for revenue discrepancies. You will reconcile data between payment processors ( Stripe, Shopify Payments, Amazon
), bank deposits, our internal database, and accounting ( QuickBooks
) to ensure every dollar is accounted for.
Spend Reconciliation:
Reconcile marketing spend across ad platforms and invoices against finance records.
Root Cause Fixes:
Work with Finance and our Data Engineer to fix discrepancies at the source.
Metric Definitions:
Document the business logic behind financial metrics so every team uses the same definitions.

4. Data Transformation & Visualization

Data Preparation:
While we have a Data Engineer managing the infrastructure, you will handle the "last mile" of data prep using KNIME
or dbt
(or similar tools like Alteryx or Python/Pandas).
Business Logic Application:
Write efficient SQL to transform raw transaction data in Snowflake
into usable datasets that reflect our financial business rules.
Dashboarding:
Design, build, and maintain high-impact dashboards in Sigma
for Finance and leadership.

What We're Looking For

The Essentials (Experience & Tech Stack)

Experience Level:
2–3 years of specific Data Analysis experience, ideally supporting finance. (We are not looking for Junior Analysts or Senior Data Architects; we need a hands-on mid-level executor.)
Forecasting:
Hands-on experience building and maintaining financial forecasts (e.g., revenue, orders, or expenses) in SQL, spreadsheets, or a BI tool. This is required.
Financial Acumen:
Comfort with revenue recognition, COGS, gross vs. net sales, and contribution margin.
Industry:
Proven experience in DTC E-commerce
is required. You must be comfortable with Shopify
, Amazon Seller Central
, and Stripe
data.
Warehousing & BI:
Strong proficiency with Snowflake
(SQL) and Sigma
. We're open to candidates experienced with Tableau, Looker, or Power BI who can adapt quickly.
Spreadsheets:
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
Transformation Tools:
Competency in KNIME
or dbt
is preferred, but we are open to candidates experienced with Alteryx
or Python
who can adapt quickly.
ELT Familiarity:
Awareness of how ELT tools (like Hevo, Fivetran, Airbyte, Azure
, etc.) function, so you can communicate effectively with our Data Engineer.

The "Financial Data Master" Skill Set

You have built or maintained forecasts that Finance relied on, and you can explain why actuals came in above or below them.
You understand how a Shopify order becomes a processor payout and then a bank deposit, and where fees, refunds, and chargebacks create gaps.
Understanding QuickBooks
report structures is a plus.

The Financial Mindset

You have the patience and precision to trace a single transaction through the entire data lifecycle to solve revenue mismatches.
You'd rather be right than fast, but you're fast too.

What We Offer

Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance

Monthly WFH stipend
Generous Paid Time Off program

Do you have strong technical skills in research and data analysis? Are you interested in making a meaningful impact on the lives children and families across California? If so, consider joining the Fiscal Forecasting Branch (FFB) at the California Department of Social Services (CDSS) as a Research Data Analyst (RDA) II, also considering RDA I. This position is part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to serving, aiding and protecting children and adults in ways that strengthen and preserve families, encourage personal responsibility and foster independence. We are looking for a highly motivated Research Data Analyst I/II (RDA I/II) with strong analytical skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment to join the Children’s Estimates Unit of the Fiscal Forecasting Branch (FFB) team. The Children’s Estimates Unit develops the annual Local Assistance Governor’s Budget and May Revision update for Children’s programs administered by the County Welfare Departments. The RDA II’s serve as a senior analysts that working with minimal direction, while the RDA I supports complex analysis under general direction. With all of the information available today, it takes a skilled all-source analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. As a defense industries all-source analyst, you use your specialized functional experience and your attention to detail to conduct all-source analytic production on foreign defense industrial programs, infrastructure, and capabilities supporting a foreign country’s ability to develop, equip, sustain, and employ its military forces across basic, strategic, and military industrial sectors.

As a Defense Industries All-Source Analyst on our team, you’ll help your client by providing intelligence production and briefing support to address dynamic intelligence requirements. Using your comprehensive understanding of all-source analytic tradecraft, production cycles, publication standards, community writing styles, and formats, you’ll produce strategic-level assessments and products that address the research, development, acquisition, test, evaluation and production of foreign weapon systems and equipment. As an authority on your topic, your client will look to you for comprehensive production, often under pressure.

This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skill set in areas like analysis, writing, and communication. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources to learn new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation’s leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

Knowledge of IC and Combatant Command environments
Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings

Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team environment that fosters our goal of delivering renewable solutions to lead the transition to a sustainable energy future.

Benefits & Perks

EDF power solutions offers best-in-class employee benefits, including the following:

Competitive bonus incentives. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.
Comprehensive health coverage. We provide low-cost health & wellness coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
Rewarding 401k. We provide a generous matching contribution.

We Are Also Proud To Offer

Favorable paid time off programs, including paid parental leave after one year of service.
Rewarding learning & career development and advancement opportunities.
Supportive mentorship & buddy programs.

Salary Range
:
The full pay range for this role is $107,200 to $178,600 annually, and the good faith estimated starting pay for this position upon hire is $128,610 to $150,045 annually. We generally base our salary decisions on factors including but not limited to, relevant work and leadership experience, education, demonstrated performance, internal equity, and in some cases, geographic location.

Scope of Job
:
Under the direction of the Senior Project Manager or Associate/Director - Project Management, the Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects and phases of multiple solar EPC projects and programs simultaneously. The Project Manager is primarily responsible for collaboration with project stakeholders such as owners, utilities, landowners, municipalities, developers, consultants, subcontractors, and other project partners and internal resources such as engineering and construction professionals. The Project Manager will achieve project and corporate goals which are generally described as follows: project schedule, project scope management, budget performance, quality assurance requirements, and construction safety. The Project Manager will foster a cooperative relationship with project partners, external owners/clients, and internal resources while meeting the company strategic goals and continually messaging the value of the company services to stakeholders. This position has project P&L responsibility.

Responsibilities

Oversee and manage the delivery of multiple Company projects on time, on budget, and in accordance with all applicable health, safety, contract, quality, and legal requirements; coordinate, supervise, and manage project team consisting of internal resources (i.e., Project Engineers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Superintendents, Design Engineers, and Project Administrators) and outside partners such as subcontractors, consultants, clients, utilities, development partners; take direct responsibility for all aspects of project delivery, where necessary; secure subcontractors; lead team in vetting, qualifying, referencing, scoping, price negotiation, and contracting with subcontractors; implement and manage project administration, site safety, and field quality control, including project meetings, document control, submittals, safety and staff planning, quality control, construction team planning and documentation, and other close‑out and commissioning of projects.
Manage budget, expenses, revenue, margin, and schedule for multiple simultaneous projects; track project actual P&L vs. plan on a monthly basis and take corrective action to meet objectives; accurately forecast project revenues, cost, and margins. Manage subcontractor payments and project billings. Create baseline schedule and maintain weekly and monthly project schedule updates in MS Project and/or Primavera.
Implement health and safety along with quality assurance program for each project; manage project compliance with health and safety as well as inspection & test plans, including compliance by company personnel, subcontractors, customers, and others at the project site; assure continuous compliance by project and subcontractors with requirements of all project contracts, subcontracts, applicable laws, and applicable permits; take primary responsibility for understanding and applying federal, state, and local code and regulatory requirements.
Implement and manage processes to secure and maintain required approvals from customers, interconnection providers, and local authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs); assure accurate and timely submittals to customers, interconnection providers, and AHJs.
Support internal origination, development, financing, and engineering teams on project matters, including project pricing, technical design, compliance with site requirements, permitting, and other constraints; perform project diligence, including site reconnaissance, geotech, and investigations; attend AHJ meetings, oversee and provide input on preparation of project design and construction documentation and plans.
Report on projects to internal and external colleagues and project stakeholders; manage project details and update project progress on Company project management platform along with other duties as assigned.

Supervision of Others : Project task level supervision and direction of matrix-based project staff, including Project Engineers, Construction Managers, Project Coordinators, Superintendents, and Project Administrators; as well as supervision of external project subcontractors and vendors.

Working Conditions : Work time will be spent both at project sites (outdoor construction sites) and in an office environment, with use of computers, telephone, and other office equipment. Travel is expected to be 25% of overall work time.

Fiscal Responsibilities : Project Profit/Loss responsibility.

Qualifications

Education/Experience :

BA/BS degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related discipline required.
5-7+ years progressive experience in construction and/or development, including as a Project Manager, Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Development Engineer, or Project Superintendent.
Prior experience managing community solar and/or utility scale photovoltaic systems of greater than 3-5 MW, and preferably greater than 10 MW. Must have managed multiple community scale solar projects simultaneously.
Experienced in solar interconnects into the utility distribution and/or transmission grids at 12kv or greater.
Advanced understanding of contracts, plans, specifications, codes, design/build contracts, and construction means and methods.
Experienced with land development and project financial closing requirements.
Experience with large-scale cut and fill earthwork or landfill construction required.
Experience with subcontracting industrial or large commercial electrical work required.

Strong knowledge of contract language and contract negotiations
Understanding of project cost accounting and tracking procedures
Ability to create and execute project work plans
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to work with both internal colleagues and external customers and subcontractors
Strong experience in construction logistics, scheduling, estimating, and budgeting
A commitment to a safe working environment
Ability to adapt easily and accept changing situations
Ability to multi-task and prioritize
Detail orientated
Prior experience utilizing Procore for solar project management, contracting, and quality control.

Stakeholder Coordination. Coordinate with OCI Product Management, VA Business Owners, and technical teams to keep priorities and delivery aligned.
Quality and Compliance. Confirm project work meets acceptance criteria, VA privacy and security requirements, and artifact management standards.

Master’s degree.

Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

new_jobs.title: Greenhouse Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Horticultural Society of New York (The Hort) seeks a creative and strategic Greenhouse Program Manager to lead educational programming, community engagement, and public events at the Greenhouse and Education Center at Denny Farrell Riverbank State Park. Reporting to the Director of the Greenhouse and Education Center and with the support of GPSWFs, the Greenhouse Program Manager will be responsible for the implementation of a diverse portfolio of horticulture-based educational experiences serving children, families, educators, older adults, workforce development participants, and community members. This individual will position the Greenhouse and Education Center as a vibrant destination for learning, wellness, environmental stewardship, and community connection.

The Horticultural Society of New York brings plants into the places where daily life happens, especially in neighborhoods with the least access to green space. We turn “unplantable” urban spaces—sidewalks, medians, traffic triangles, and streets—into gardens and plantings that last. We engage communities through learning, wellness, and paid work, so the benefits of plants are more accessible to New Yorkers across our city.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Curriculum Implementation

Implement, and oversee educational programming for diverse audiences.
Administer directly and support others in delivering The Hort’s seasonal and year-round curricula rooted in horticulture, environmental education, food growing, and community stewardship.
Ensure internal and externally facilitated programming that aligns with The Hort's mission and strategic priorities.
Evaluate and continuously improve program quality and participant outcomes.

Daily operations and scheduling

Serve as the point of contact person on-site across assigned shifts, including opening and closing.
Resolve front-line problems and maintain a safe, orderly, welcoming site.
Prepare spaces, materials, and setups for booked programs and guest-facilitated sessions.
Coordinate the weekly scheduling of staff assigned to the Greenhouse.
Support all program logistics, including space, scheduling, and daily presence.

Program Management & Staff Supervision

Supervise educators, facilitators, and interns assigned to work at the Greenhouse
Provide coaching, training, and professional development opportunities.
Ensure program delivery is consistent, inclusive, and high quality.

Events & Public Programming

Lead plant-focused community events, seasonal celebrations, workshops, exhibitions, and open houses.
Coordinate logistics with operations staff and external partners.
Support fundraising and donor engagement events held at the site.

Evaluation, Grants & Administration

Support tracking participation metrics and program outcomes.
Prepare reports for grants, funders, and organizational leadership.
Assist with program budgets and strategic planning.
Other tasks, as directed

Qualifications

Experience managing program delivery and front-line staff, ideally at a community, education, or public-facing site.
2+years of experience managing educational or community programs.
Experience delivering curriculum and facilitating learning for diverse audiences.
Strong operational skills for scheduling and staff management.
Familiarity with horticulture, gardening, urban agriculture, or environmental education preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Bilingual (Spanish/ English)
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PPT, etc.)

Physical Requirements

Able to lift 50+ pounds and comfortable working outside in all weather conditions.
Ability to squat, lift, stretch, bend, sit and stand for extended periods of time
Ability to perform physical labor outside in all weather conditions.
Comfort navigating the subway, bus, streets, and other modes of transportation throughout NYC

Benefits

The Hort offers all Full-Time regular employees a generous Paid Time Off package, term life insurance policy, and Employee Assistance Program. Pre-tax benefits include transit, Flexible Spending Account, medical, dental, and vision insurance. A 401(k)-retirement plan is available after one year of service.

Additional Details

Schedule: Sunday-Thursday 10am-6pm
Work Locations: Denny Farrell Riverbank State Park Greenhouse and Education Center, and other approved locations
Reports to: Director, Greenhouse and Education Center
Salary: 66,300-68,000 annual salary
Background Check: Facilitators may be screened by the DOE Office of Personnel Investigation and submit fingerprints

How To Apply

Please include a brief cover letter detailing your interests along with the completed application and resume. To be considered, click here to submit your application and required materials. Only complete applications will be reviewed. No phone calls.

Please be advised that due to the high volume of applicants, we can only contact candidates whose skills and background best fit the open positions' needs. Thank you for your interest in employment opportunities at The Horticultural Society of New York.
